value.rationale: The independence schema is a central distinguishing axiom for complete upward (cup) belief semantics. Its sharp all-arity countermodel threshold identifies the minimal local-state resource needed for failure in upward impure models, shows only one doubled agent state is necessary, and improves the first binary example. It yields a natural benchmark for finite countermodel construction rather than an arbitrary fixed small-case count.
